mainEntity.name: What kind of data does AI SEO use to optimize my roofing company's online presence?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI SEO utilizes a diverse range of data points to optimize a roofing company's online presence. This includes search query data, competitor analysis (websites, keywords, backlinks), local geographic data, customer demographics and behavior patterns, website analytics, social media trends, and even weather-related search spikes relevant to roofing needs. By analyzing these complex datasets, AI can uncover actionable insights to improve keyword rankings, content relevance, and local targeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI SEO uses search queries, competitor data, local geography, customer behavior, website analytics, and social trends to optimize roofing company's online presence.
